cc:Work.dc:title: Grey Noise (Hearing)
cc:Work.dc:description: Grey, by hearing. 20 Hz → 700 nm; 12.5 kHz → 380 nm. A chosen audio-to-light mapping; color outside sRGB. 380–700 nm; curve normalized to its peak. CIE 1931 2 degree observer; direct sRGB/D65 conversion; peak linear RGB=1. Background #FF0052; clipped channels: G.

cc:Agent.dc:title: CIE (2019), doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b. CIE data and derived figure: CC BY-SA 4.0.
